Job Description

Dunn Solutions Group helps our clients leverage technology to better run their businesses. Our consultants have direct client contact and work on a variety of technologies and platforms. We are looking for an experienced .Net developer to join our team. We'd like someone with a solid background in .Net, SQLServer, ASP.Net, VB.NET, VBScript, C#, Oracle, MVC, SharePoint and consulting experience to work with our clients on full life cycle application development projects based out of our Minneapolis office. Opportunities for project leadership and growth.

Desired Skills & Experience

Qualifications Include: B.S. in Computer Science or equivalent work experience Minimum of 5+ years of .Net and SQLServer experience Experience with ASP.net, VB.net, JavaScript, C# , MVC, Oracle, SharePoint 2010 Strong communication skills, both written and oral Excellent teamwork and interpersonal skills Aptitude for trouble-shooting and problem-solving Software methodology experience Experience interacting with business and end user clients

The position is Full-Time Permanent salaried with benefits. Our benefits include an attractive compensation package, bonus programs, health, and dental plans, 401(k), and tuition assistance. Some travel may be required.
